versions.changelog:
- Initial release of browser-auto-download skill.
- Added support for intelligent, browser-based file downloads via automated navigation and platform detection.
- Handles multi-step download flows, auto-downloads triggered on page load, and dynamic content rendering.
- Includes extended documentation and publishing/release notes.
- Provides page scrolling for lazy content, extended wait times, and Golang support.

- Initial release of browser-auto-download skill.
- Automates file downloads from dynamic web pages with enhanced features.
- Detects platform automatically (Windows/macOS/Linux; 64/32-bit; ARM/Intel).
- Handles multi-step navigation to platform-specific download pages.
- Captures auto-downloads triggered on page load and falls back to button clicking when needed.
- Provides troubleshooting tips, detailed usage examples, and integration instructions.
